surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between Sb(OEt)3 and (Me3Si)2Se followed by Te substitution for Se in the Sb2Se3 film during the GeTe2 subcycle.
evidence: The substitution reaction can be described as the reaction shown below. Sb2Se3 + 3(Me3Si)2Te → Sb2Te3 + 3(Me3Si)2Se. According to the hard-soft Lewis acid-based theory, the unfavorable Lewis acid-base pair between the trimethylsilyl group and Te in (Me3Si)2Te can cause a ligand exchange reaction to form the harder Lewis acid-base pair in (Me3Si)2Se, which replaces Se with Te in the Sb2Se3 film.
